dataset.description: New public-original extraction for the 100 archive IDs in the saved August 2026 feature catalogue; not historical August descriptors or the evolving live catalogue.

extraction.decoder: Chromium HTMLImageElement.decode() of verified original PNG/JPEG bytes
extraction.originalRequestPolicy: Sequential public GET, no query, no redirects, 60 second timeout, 256 MiB maximum; reuse URL/checksum-bound cached originals
extraction.canvas: Default Canvas2D sRGB with willReadFrequently:true; transparent initial canvas; drawImage; default imageSmoothingEnabled:true and imageSmoothingQuality:low
extraction.resize: Longest side at most 1024; no upscale; max(1, Math.round(sourceDimension * ratio)); browser default image orientation/color management
extraction.raster: getImageData RGBA8, unpremultiplied encoded sRGB channels; row-major RGBA bytes
extraction.alpha: weight = A/255; skip alpha <= 0; weightSum = sum(weight); sums = sum(encoded channel * weight); RGB = sums/(weightSum || 1); no background compositing, no linear-light averaging
extraction.descriptor: measureMeanRgb then featureFromRgb; LAB = rgbToLab(mean encoded RGB), D65; longSide is original decoded longest side
extraction.analysisPng: Lossless PNG encoded with Sharp directly from Chromium analysis RGBA; never used as extraction input
extraction.thumbnails: Sharp WebP quality 88 from the same analysis RGBA; width up to 560 for 112/27/65, up to 160 otherwise; aspect retained, no upscale
extraction.patch: Central 4x4 analysis pixels; zero-based top-left x,y; row-major RGBA; illustrative patch only, full raster supplies mean
extraction.reproducibility: Cache preserves original bytes; rerunning uses installed Chromium and records a new snapshotAt. Browser version changes can change raster results.
